description: A script for running and monitoring a gateway watch regression test, including argument parsing, directory snapshotting, process control, and result analysis.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to override default options.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parent directories.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a file path.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Lists all files and directories under a root directory.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of directory contents and statistics.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Writes directory snapshot data to a specified folder.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously and throws on failure.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Builds command and environment for timed watch process.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Parses timing information from a log file.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Runs a watch process with timing and process control.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a list of file paths from a text file.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Computes and writes differences between directory snapshots.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs a failure message to stderr.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Detects the reason for a build trigger from stdout/stderr logs.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Builds environment and configuration for run-node dependency resolution.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function orchestrating the regression test process.
